<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Jordan 2026-09-02: 'if Claude does not have a pij seat, register for one in its current seat so I do not have to type /pij ready; Claude just loads with a pij id.' Investigation (prime subagent, file:line): the statusline (~/.claude/statusline-context.sh:37-51) is READ-ONLY — `pij whoami` parsed for the ⛓ id; it never adopts; what Jordan saw appear today is pane-based resolution now working (identity.rs:698-728). Adopting FROM the statusline is wrong: it runs on every render (~300ms throttle), on the render path, and a non-tmux Claude would fail every render. The right mechanism is a Claude **SessionStart hook** (fires once per session, off the hot path, sees CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; the slot is free in ~/.claude/settings.json). rs adopt is already idempotent on a live-owned pane (identity.rs:470-480 adopts INTO the existing owner), so a second session in the same pane does not mint a second id. Legacy TS adopt is only partially idempotent (cli.ts:2952-2967 via pendingPaneOccupant) — not in scope, adopt routes to rs.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 Hook script shipped in the repo: if $TMUX_PANE is set and the rs daemon answers, run `pij-rs adopt "$TMUX_PANE" --harness claude` idempotently; on success emit only contract-valid SessionStart context JSON so the initial statusline refreshes after adoption; on refusal/no-tmux/no-daemon exit 0 with empty stderr and one diagnostic log line, never block session start.
- G2 Installer: extend plan 126's ensure path (crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs, same backup + additive-JSON discipline) to ALSO ensure a SessionStart hook entry pointing at the shipped script in every Claude home; idempotent; `pij-rs doctor claude-hook` reports state; run at daemon boot alongside the accept ensure.
- G3 Statusline stays read-only; guard its pij block with `[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ]` so non-tmux sessions skip the node spawn (the statusline script lives in ~/.claude; the installer may patch ONLY that guard, with backup, or the plan documents the one-line operator edit — PM decides and records).
- G4 The adopted seat gets consent stamped (s121) so the very first inbound message lands as a real turn.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No statusline adoption.
- No change to legacy TS adopt idempotence (req-0026 family).
- No change to /pij ready (it remains valid and becomes a no-op when the hook already adopted).
